cases.sentence: Господи, как много стало у меня ___.
cases.explain: The genitive plural врагов is used after the numeral много (many) to indicate quantity.

cases.sentence: Как много тех, кто поднимается ___ меня.
cases.explain: The preposition против (against) governs the genitive case to show opposition.

cases.sentence: Но ты, Господи, ___ мне, ты слава моя.
cases.explain: Щит is a predicate nominative in 'You are a shield,' requiring nominative case.
Голову is the direct object of the transitive verb возносишь (lift), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: И он отвечает мне из своей святой ___.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from) requires the genitive case to show source or origin.

cases.sentence: Не устрашусь я десятков тысяч ___ мне.
cases.explain: The preposition вокруг (around) governs the genitive case to indicate surrounding position.

cases.sentence: Порази всех врагов моих в ___, сокруши нечестивым зубы.
cases.explain: The instrumental case оружием shows the means or instrument by which the action is performed.

cases.sentence: Да будет благословение Твое на ___ Твоем.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) with location takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Господи, как много стало у меня врагов, как много тех, кто поднимается против меня.
reading.question: What is David's primary complaint in the opening of this psalm?
options: He has many enemies who rise up against him
His father is angry with him
reading.correct: He has many enemies who rise up against him
reading.explain: David begins by lamenting the increase of his enemies and those who oppose him.

reading.ru: Многие говорят обо мне, Бог его не спасет.
reading.question: What do David's enemies claim about God's ability to save him?
options: They say God will not save him
They say God will help him greatly
They say God is pleased with him
They say God will make him king
reading.correct: They say God will not save him
reading.explain: David's enemies mock him by claiming God will not deliver or save him.

reading.ru: Но ты, Господи, щит мне, ты слава моя. Ты возносишь голову мою.
reading.question: How does David express confidence in God despite his enemies?
options: God is his shield and glory, lifting up his head from shame
David will defeat his enemies himself
His enemies will simply leave him alone
David will hide until danger passes
reading.correct: God is his shield and glory, lifting up his head from shame
reading.explain: David trusts that God is his protection, honor, and defender who restores his dignity.

reading.ru: Ложусь я и сплю, и пробуждаюсь опять, ведь Господь поддерживает меня.
reading.question: What remarkable confidence does David express about his sleep?
options: He can lie down and sleep peacefully because God sustains him
He never sleeps due to constant fear
He dreams of defeating all enemies
He remains terrified even in sleep
reading.correct: He can lie down and sleep peacefully because God sustains him
reading.explain: Despite overwhelming enemies, David sleeps peacefully, confident in God's protection.

reading.ru: Не устрашусь я десятков тысяч со всех сторон меня обступивших.
reading.question: How many enemies surround David and what is his attitude?
options: Tens of thousands surround him from all sides, yet he will not fear
Only a few enemies threaten him
David is terrified by the surrounding forces
The enemies number less than one thousand
reading.correct: Tens of thousands surround him from all sides, yet he will not fear
reading.explain: Despite overwhelming numbers encircling him, David declares his fearlessness in God.

reading.ru: Господи, восстань, помоги мне, мой Бог. Порази всех врагов моих в челюсть, сокруши нечестивым зубы.
reading.question: What divine action does David request against his enemies?
options: Strike them on the cheekbone and break the teeth of the wicked
Leave him to fight his enemies alone
Give his enemies power over him
reading.correct: Strike them on the cheekbone and break the teeth of the wicked
reading.explain: David calls on God to strike his enemies violently, breaking their strength and power.
